name: Executive Office
mission: Set direction, allocate capital, and keep the company honest about its numbers and its people.

name: Human Resources (People & Culture)
mission: Hire well, pay fairly, keep the rules clear and make Zenvora a place people choose to stay.

name: Finance & Accounts
mission: Keep Zenvora solvent, compliant and able to see its numbers within five working days of month end.

name: Backend Engineering
mission: Build and run the services behind Pulse and Ledger so they stay fast, correct and cheap to operate.

name: Frontend & Mobile Engineering
mission: Ship the web and mobile apps customers touch every day, and keep them accessible and fast.

name: Data & AI
mission: Turn conversation and finance data into products, insight and dependable machine learning.

name: Quality Assurance
mission: Make sure what we release works, and that we can prove it.

name: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
mission: Give every engineer a safe, fast path to production and keep production up.

name: Product & Design
mission: Decide what to build and make it simple to use.

name: Sales & Marketing
mission: Find the right customers, win them honestly and tell Zenvora's story clearly.

name: Customer Support (Zenvora Care)
mission: Answer customers fast and fully on behalf of Zenvora and of the brands that outsource support to Zenvora Care.

name: IT & Information Security
mission: Keep devices, accounts and data safe, and make the tools work for everyone.
